name: Time cell
purpose: The compact RelativeTime presentation for a data-grid timestamp.
description: Fit readable timestamps into compact columns.

props.name: now
props.description: Supply a reference time for deterministic historical displays and stories.

guidance.overview: The compact RelativeTime presentation for a data-grid timestamp.
usage: Supply a Date or timestamp string and a fixed now when displaying a historical snapshot.
The default timezone is UTC. Keep date columns consistently aligned and use a heading that names the date’s meaning.
accessibility: The underlying time element includes a machine-readable datetime and a complete absolute timestamp in its accessible label.
Keyboard focus exposes the same absolute-time tooltip as pointer hover.
context: Use for Created, Updated, and other recent timestamps where elapsed time is useful.
